text:
alex: heads-up — onboarding doc + edge sample broke for a customer. tsc inference drops generics when SDK imported as ESM in their app. runtime works, types don't.

mona: can you paste the tsconfig + a tiny repro?

alex: repro: 
```json
{ "compilerOptions": { "module": "ESNext", "moduleResolution": "bundler", "strict": true, "lib": ["ES2022","DOM"] } }
```
and code: 
```ts
import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference-js'
const c = createClient<{me:{id:string}}>({})
// later c.me.id shows up as error or c is any
```

ryan: likely two things: (1) our package `exports` doesn't include a types-specific path for the import entry so TS resolves a flattened d.ts that picks the non-generic overload; (2) we have a fallback overload using `any` which wins during overload resolution. both cause inference to collapse.

mona: +1. Also the edge sample expects `globalThis.crypto.subtle`, some local devs lack that polyfill and conditional types widen to unknown which hurts inference.

alex: short-term sample patch idea: add a local `types` entry in sample package.json pointing at `dist/esm/index.d.ts` so tsc uses correct defs. longer term we should publish `exports.import.types` in SDK.

ryan: please also avoid `any` fallback overloads. use a single generic signature or at least `unknown` with constrained generics so inference prefers the generic branch.

mona: action items: 
- add `exports.import.types` -> `./dist/index.mts.d.ts` (types-only ESM entry)
- refactor `createClient`/`retry` overloads to remove `any` fallback and make generic primary
- add CI integration test: run tsc against samples/edge with moduleResolution=bundler and skipLibCheck=false
- doc blurb in onboarding noting recommended tsconfig and crypto polyfill for local devs

ci-bot: created issue devex/1499 (sdk: esm types -> inference loss) and queued a CI job to run the repro matrix.

alex: I'll open a draft PR for the exports/types mapping + overload cleanup. tagging ryan for type review.

ryan: once PR lands I'll add the TS integration and test against esbuild, bun, and node. also we should add a tiny repro in `devx/edge-typed-repro` so we don't regress.

mona: nice. if anyone hits this locally, temporary workaround is `const c = createClient({}) as unknown as Client<{me:{id:string}}>` until types propagate. ugly but works.

alex: thanks team — assigning PR to me, CI to ryan. ping if you need the exact customer repro. :thumbsup:
